The recipe window, canonical typed trace, exact attach/detach slice indices, all four active-strand endpoint states, source/target transport event lists, exact interpreted source/target contexts, common role-aware exterior, moving/stationary labels, positive/negative local boundary objects, complete source-to-target coefficient transport, the orientation-dependent residual moving-character coefficient, exact scalar reconstruction, and independent positive- and negative-orientation morphism-level fusion-channel sums are kernel-bound. The exact CleanWindow requires a category-neutral StandardOrientedBandTransport witness supplied only through T4. What remains is construction of the clean graphical ClosedWindow and its exact source/target endpoint factorizations.
active_blocker.required_resolution: Replace the presently constructor-free StandardOrientedBandTransport shell by an explicit category-neutral standard-band normal-form witness, then construct StandardBandEndpointCompiler from that witness and the exact role-aware contexts. The three category-level literature laws are separate and cannot manufacture presentation endpoints. The moving coefficient and its channel-character reconstruction are now derived rather than supplied. proved_internal_obligations.meaning: Ordinary components use the ordinary Kirby colour; dotted components use only the normalized tensor-unit cut.
The cycle-level formula descends to the handle-chain H2 class without modular killing.
The case split is source-bound for all eight moves, but the two-over-two branch explicitly requires the unresolved StandardBandEndpointCompiler and is therefore conditional.
Conditional on StandardBandEndpointCompiler, every admitted elementary move preserves the presentation formula, so finite Kirby movies preserve it.

A clean 2/2 certificate can no longer point at unrelated declared slices. Its attach and detach slices are uniquely tied to the exact canonical trace states at the replacement-window entrance and exit, and the replacement windows are exactly the recorded transport event lists.

The exact source-bound clean window cannot enter the categorical endpoint route unless T4 certifies its literal transport event lists as the two sides of the standard oriented band normal form. This topology witness contains no category, character, label, evaluator, or scalar equality.

The source and target evaluator terms are tied to one role-aware exterior. The moving and stationary ordinary labels and both oriented two-strand boundary objects are derived from the same structural binding, so the new route no longer borrows the legacy local-boundary decoder.

For every remaining-label block and every moving/stationary simple pair, the target coefficient is proved equal to the exact source coefficient, including both character powers. The outer moving coefficient is computed from the unit/unit complement, moving quantum dimension, orientation, and residual exponent; it is no longer a field of the unresolved endpoint obligation. Lean also proves that the residual moving coefficient times the visible channel coupon reconstructs the exact original coefficient: positive orientation uses (a+b)+(-b)=a, while negative orientation uses (a-b)+b=a.

For the negative endpoint x tensor y, Lean independently sums every simple z and every multiplicity coordinate mu, transports the common character coupon through that internal channel, and proves that the residual moving coupon plus the channel coupon reconstruct the two original handle coupons. This does not reuse the positive endpoint through an unrecorded mirror.
No second modular invariance proof or modular killing assumption is used by the public modular theorem.
